title: I Created a optimizer for TradingView Pine Script Strategy it generate best inputs automatically
author: dkcodenut
selftext:
Hey Traders!

As title says, I built a optimizer that allows people to automatically do quick scan for any strategy, anyone can access it for free and download it’s report. 

I know everyone use tradingview strategy but don’t know which length, source, session, timeframe performs better so this optimizer will scan all your strategy inputs and will give you top performance.

Allows private as well as public strategies, scan based on robust score, max winrate, profit, drawdown. The best that I love to use is Genetic Algorithm it gives final result.

I pretend to extend this to a point where we add Ant Colony, Differential Evolution Algorithms. I got great feedback from current users so I hope everyone find it useful. 

Oh, it's free to test so don't worry! you don't even need to sign-in :)

replies.author: dkcodenut
replies.body:
I tested multiple options, but none of them work smoothly or are up to date. We need to maintain our Optimizer updates because TradingView continuously updates its visuals.  
My Optimizer also detect sessions, timeframes and it important to test while backtesting.
